questions.requirements:
不运行下方SQL，手工推算其在公开夹具中的完整返回结果。保留列名和重复行；明确区分NULL、空字符串和数值。
原始名称去两侧空格后、非空且非空串，返回重复名称 clean_name、行数 n（>1），按名称升序。
输出列名称及顺序：clean_name, n。按题设排序；参考排序键：clean_name。 未指定舍入时保留原计算精度；NULL、零、空字符串不同。

questions.title: 保留规范化重名中编号最小者
questions.context: 使用课程中小型原始导入资料数据练习保留规范化重名中编号最小者。教学表中的金额以模拟元为单位，不使用企业库的整数分口径。
questions.requirements:
用 TRIM 后的非空名称分组，保留编号最小的记录，输出 id、clean_name、amount，按 id 升序。
输出列名称及顺序：id, clean_name, amount。按题设排序；参考排序键：id。 未指定舍入时保留原计算精度；NULL、零、空字符串不同。

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT id,TRIM(name) AS clean_name,amount,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRIM(name) ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM raw_data WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(name)<>'') SELECT id,clean_name,amount FROM a WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY id
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT id,TRIM(name) AS clean_name,amount,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRIM(name) ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM raw_data WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(name)<>'') SELECT id,clean_name,amount FROM a WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY id

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT id,TRIM(name) AS clean_name,amount,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRIM(name) ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM raw_data WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(name)<>'') SELECT id,clean_name,amount FROM a WHERE NOT (rn<>1) ORDER BY id
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT id,TRIM(name) AS clean_name,amount,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRIM(name) ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM raw_data WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(name)<>'') SELECT id,clean_name,amount FROM a WHERE NOT (rn<>1) ORDER BY id
referenceSolutions.explanation: 用反向比较并取 NOT 表达相同三值逻辑。

questions.title: 分类映射后计数
questions.context: 使用课程中小型原始导入资料数据练习分类映射后计数。教学表中的金额以模拟元为单位，不使用企业库的整数分口径。
questions.requirements:
将规范化类别 skin/home 映射“个护”“家居”，其他（含NULL）为“其他”；按映射类别输出 clean_category、n，按类别升序。
输出列名称及顺序：clean_category, n。按题设排序；参考排序键：clean_category。 未指定舍入时保留原计算精度；NULL、零、空字符串不同。

referenceSolutions.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='skin' THEN '个护' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='home' THEN '家居' ELSE '其他' END AS clean_category FROM raw_data) SELECT clean_category,COUNT(*) AS n FROM a GROUP BY clean_category ORDER BY clean_category
referenceSolutions.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='skin' THEN '个护' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(category))='home' THEN '家居' ELSE '其他' END AS clean_category FROM raw_data) SELECT clean_category,COUNT(*) AS n FROM a GROUP BY clean_category ORDER BY clean_category
